name: multi_asset_signal_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Individual stock movements are driven by both idiosyncratic and systematic factors. By monitoring NIFTY 50, Bank NIFTY, and India VIX simultaneously, we can extract a cross-asset macro signal that identifies regime shifts before they fully propagate to individual stocks. Specifically: when NIFTY rises but VIX also rises (unusual divergence), it signals institutional hedging and an imminent pullback. When NIFTY falls but VIX falls (complacency), it signals a likely bounce. Bank NIFTY vs NIFTY relative performance provides sector rotation information. The inefficiency exists because most intraday traders focus on single-stock technicals and ignore cross-asset information available in real-time.
mechanism: VIX measures implied volatility premium. When VIX is elevated, options market makers carry large gamma exposure, causing them to delta-hedge aggressively — buying into rallies and selling into dips. This amplifies directional moves in spot. Conversely, low VIX environments produce smoother, more predictable mean-reverting behavior in the underlying.

conditions: NIFTY_ROC_15 < -15 bps AND VIX_ROC_15 < 0 (NIFTY down but VIX also down — complacent dip)
Stock close < vwap AND RSI(close, 14) < 40 (stock oversold in dip)
NIFTY_ROC_15 > 15 bps AND VIX_ROC_15 > 0 (NIFTY up but VIX also up — hedging divergence)
Stock close > vwap AND RSI(close, 14) > 60 (stock overbought in rally)

exit.signal_exit: Divergence_Signal flips (NIFTY and VIX re-align in normal relationship)

filters.vix_filter: India VIX between 12-28 (outside this range, NIFTY-VIX relationship is non-linear)

weaknesses: India VIX is updated every 15 seconds, not every second — the 1-min bar for VIX is constructed from sparse data points, making VIX_ROC_15 noisier than price-based indicators
NIFTY-VIX divergence is a necessary but not sufficient condition for reversal — divergences can persist for 1-2 hours in trending markets, leading to premature counter-trend entries
Selecting a single high-beta stock to express the macro view concentrates idiosyncratic risk; the stock may not respond to the macro signal if it has its own news/events
prior_art: VIX-equity divergence trading is well-known in US markets (CBOE VIX); Dennis & Mayhew (2002) on implied vol dynamics; India-specific application less documented; Bank NIFTY relative strength used by prop traders
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
